title: Verification · Espaço Prelúdio
meta: Validation of your professional council · Manual review by the team

why.p: Patients need to know whether the practitioner they're going to consult truly has active registration and is authorized to provide online care under their professional council's regulations (CFP Resolution 11/2018 for psychologists, CFM 2.314/2022 for physicians, and equivalents for other councils). Those who pass verification get a "Verified by team" badge on their profile.

how.intro: Send a screenshot or photo of any of these — whichever is easiest for your council:
how.li1: Professional ID card issued by the council — valid for any of the 8 councils (CRP, CRM, CRESS, CREFITO, CRFa, CRN, CRO, CREF).
how.li2Label: Official public lookup systems (show your name + registration number):
how.footnote: The document must be legible and show full name + registration number. We accept JPEG, PNG, WebP and PDF — up to 500 KB. You may blur/hide irrelevant info (CPF, ID) before sending.

form.labelDoc: Document (image or PDF, up to 500 KB)
form.placeholderNotes: E.g.: e-Psi registration no. 12345 / providing online care since 2019.

footerNote: After submission, the team reviews within 2 business days. You'll receive the response on this same page and by email.

statusCard.verifiedSubSuffix: . The "Verified" badge appears on your public profile.
statusCard.pendingSubSuffix: . The team reviews within 2 business days. You don't need to do anything else.
